title: Domain with a radical and a pole
statement:
Enter the domain of $\sqrt{x-[$a]}/(x-[$b])$ in interval notation.

[__________]{a}
hints: Include the radical’s endpoint and exclude the pole.
solution: The domain is $[[$a],[$b])\cup([$b],\infty)$ because the square root permits zero but the denominator cannot be zero.

feedback.message: Include the radical’s endpoint and exclude the pole.
